observations.body: Matthew summarizes Jesus moving through Galilee with synagogue teaching, Kingdom proclamation, and healing.
observations.label: Teaching, proclaiming, and healing through Galilee

observations.body: The passage places God’s Kingdom beside teaching, proclaiming, and healing through galilee.
observations.label: God’s Kingdom

payload.posture: Read Matthew 4:12–25 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states matthew summarizes Jesus moving through Galilee with synagogue teaching, Kingdom proclamation, and healing. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
payload.title: Teaching, proclaiming, and healing through Galilee
